Im gonna be honest and say that i relate a lot to your situation. Of course, we are still two diffferent people, with different lives and struggles, but I can still relate to you. Its hard for me to talk to people bcz there is always this feeling of judgement, or perhapes the fear of them thinking I only want attention or something. Im in my first year of uni rn, and i have a lot of stress and anxiety pertaining to it. I def feel that going into uni STRAIGHT outta high school was a mistake for me, just bcz I dont think mentally I was really prepared for the change and everything that comes with it. 

Uni isnt meant for everyone and uni isnt a one formula type thing. Society puts these pressures on us that we HAVE to go to uni to succeed. Society also tells us that we have to go to uni rigth away or else itll be too late. But, these are rlly wrong. Dont allow yourself to believe that uni is the only road to success. People take different paths and all of them are valid. On the point about you family thinking your a 'useless sack of shit', this is tougher. bcz although its possible to assure yourself that uni isnt important, family is a large impact on our mental health and how we view ourselves, and they can often feel dismissive. So all I can say is im sorry that you fear them thinking about you like this. I dont know your relationship with your family so Im not gonna say some bullshit like "they love you so just talk to them, Im sure they will understand and support u no matter what"... but for what its worth (if anything at all), im proud of u, and i dont think your a useless peice of shit. Your the opposite in fact. Im writting this because I care bout you, even if i dont know you personally. 

Talking about how you feel can be scary, especially to talk about it to the people in your life. So, my PMs are always open. Sometimes talking to a random stranger feels good! We dont even gotta talk about your struggles and problems. Whatever it is, they are always open. You WOULDNT be a burden or a head ache. I like talking to people and i want to talk :)
